actions.name: Reach the place of a backup
actions.description: Get physical access to the place where a backup is stored, including every container around it.

actions.name: Reach a device
actions.description: Get physical access to the place where a device is stored, including every container around it.

actions.name: Go to a location
actions.description: Travel to the location and get in.

actions.name: Inspect the seal of a bag
actions.description: Look at the bag for signs of opening or damage.

actions.name: Compare bag serial with the strip
actions.description: Compare the serial number on the bag with the one on its strip.

actions.name: Open a bag
actions.description: Open the bag; it must be replaced afterwards.

actions.name: Read an item from a backup
actions.description: Read, scan or recall the item. Digital media need a reader.

requires.note: reader for the medium, e.g. a computer for USB or SD

actions.name: Decrypt an item
actions.description: Decrypt the item with the key that was obtained.

actions.name: Unlock a device with its PIN
actions.description: Enter the PIN on the device.

actions.name: Enter the passphrase
actions.description: Enter the passphrase of a signer on the device that holds its seed.

actions.name: Obtain a new signing device
actions.description: Get a new device from a trustworthy source.

actions.name: Verify a firmware or software download
actions.description: Check the signature or hash of a firmware or application, or install it from a verified source.

actions.name: Check the anti-phishing words
actions.description: Compare the words shown by the device with the ones noted at setup.

actions.name: Load a seed into a hardware device
actions.description: Enter the seed words on the device itself.

actions.name: Load a seed into a hot wallet
actions.description: Enter the seed words into software on a networked computer or phone.
actions.caveat: Emergency only: the seed is exposed to the host.

actions.name: Wipe a device
actions.description: Reset the device to factory state.

actions.name: Compare fingerprints
actions.description: Check that the master fingerprint or xpub shown by the device matches the expected one.

actions.name: Export the xpub of a signer
actions.description: Export the extended public key of the signer from its device.

actions.name: Export the descriptor stored on a device
actions.description: Read the wallet configuration out of an unlocked device.

actions.name: Open the coordinator
actions.description: Start the coordinator that manages the wallet.

actions.name: Use a coordinator that already has the descriptor
actions.description: Unlock the coordinator if it has a password and open the wallet where it is still loaded.

actions.name: Install a coordinator
actions.description: Download, verify and install the coordinator software.

actions.name: Import the descriptor
actions.description: Load the descriptor into the coordinator.

actions.name: Wait for the timelock
actions.description: Wait until the relative timelock of the policy has expired.

actions.name: Build a transaction
actions.description: Create the unsigned transaction in the coordinator.

actions.name: Transfer the transaction to the device
actions.description: Move the unsigned or signed transaction between coordinator and device (SD card, USB, QR, NFC).

actions.name: Check and sign the transaction on the device
actions.description: Verify receiver, amount and change on the device screen and sign.

actions.name: Broadcast the transaction
actions.description: Send the signed transaction to the network.

actions.name: Check the balance
actions.description: Look at the wallet balance and recent transactions in a watch-only coordinator.

actions.name: Verify an address on the device
actions.description: Compare a receive or change address shown by the coordinator with the one on the device screen.

actions.name: Receive a test amount
actions.description: Receive a small amount to an address of the wallet and see it arrive.

actions.name: Generate a seed
actions.description: Generate a new seed on a device or with dice, verify its checksum.

actions.name: Check the entropy
actions.description: Recompute a manually generated seed with an independent tool, offline.

actions.name: Write a backup
actions.description: Write or stamp the item onto the chosen medium.

actions.name: Check that a copy is legible and correct
actions.description: Read the copy back and compare it with the original.

actions.name: Seal items in a new bag
actions.description: Seal the items in a new tamper-evident bag and note its serial.

actions.name: Store an item at its place
actions.description: Bring the item, bag or strip to its storage location.

actions.name: Destroy old copies
actions.description: Destroy the copies that are no longer valid.

actions.name: Set a new PIN
actions.description: Set a new PIN on the unlocked device.

actions.name: Check the device
actions.description: Check display, buttons, connectors and battery of the unlocked device.

actions.name: Inspect a location
actions.description: Check the location for damage, signs of intrusion or changes.

actions.name: Check the cloud account
actions.description: Log in and check that the account is active and the files are present.

actions.name: Update the plan
actions.description: Bring the plan document in line with the setup and re-store its copies.

actions.name: Inform the people concerned
actions.description: Tell the owners, heirs or trustees what happened or changed.

actions.name: Verify and open the enclosing bags
actions.description: From the outermost bag inwards, compare the serial with the strip, then open it.
actions.caveat: Takes the list of bags around the item, outermost first; pass `$backup.enclosing_bags` or `$device.enclosing_bags`.

actions.name: Decrypt with any of the keys
actions.description: Obtain one of the secrets the item is encrypted with and decrypt.

actions.name: Obtain one decryption key
actions.description: Any one of the secrets an item is encrypted with is enough.

actions.name: Obtain an item from one backup copy
actions.description: Reach the backup, deal with the bags around it, read the item and decrypt it if needed.
actions.caveat: Recursive through encrypted_with chains; a cycle is infeasible.

actions.name: Obtain a secret
actions.description: Get at the secret through any one of its copies in backups (or memory).

actions.name: Unlock a device
actions.description: Reach the device, deal with the bags around it, obtain the PIN and enter it.

actions.name: Use a device that holds the seed
actions.description: Unlock any device the seed is loaded on.

actions.name: Load the seed into a new device
actions.description: Obtain a new device and enter the seed on it.

actions.name: Recover a seed from a backup
actions.description: Read the seed from a backup and load it into a device; a hot wallet only in an emergency.

actions.name: Load a seed somewhere it can sign
actions.description: Alternatives: a new hardware device, or (emergency) a hot wallet.

actions.name: Access a seed
actions.description: Use a device that holds it, or recover it from a backup.

actions.name: Access a signer
actions.description: Access its seed and, if it has one, its passphrase.

actions.name: Access enough signers of a policy
actions.description: Access at least threshold-many of the signers of the policy.

actions.name: Export the descriptor from an unlocked device
actions.description: Unlock a device that stores the descriptor and read it out.

actions.name: Recover the descriptor from a backup
actions.description: Read the descriptor from a backup (decrypt if needed) and import it.

actions.name: Rebuild a default descriptor from the signers
actions.description: For a default derivation the descriptor can be rebuilt from the xpubs of all signers.
actions.caveat: Needs all signers of all policies, not only a quorum.

actions.name: Access the descriptor
actions.description: Use a coordinator that has it, export it from a device, recover it from a backup, or rebuild a default one.

actions.name: Satisfy a spending policy
actions.description: Wait for the delay, have the descriptor, and access a quorum of signers.

actions.name: Access a wallet
actions.description: Satisfy any one of its spending policies; which ones are open changes over time because of the delays.

actions.name: Send funds
actions.description: Build, transfer, sign and broadcast a transaction.

actions.name: Create a new wallet
actions.description: Generate seeds, prepare devices, write and verify backups, store them, update the plan.

actions.name: Sweep a wallet
actions.description: Access the wallet and move all funds to a new wallet.
actions.caveat: Which threats call for a sweep depends on the analysis: it only helps while the owners can still satisfy a policy before the attacker does.

actions.name: Replace a compromised seed
actions.description: Create a new wallet without the seed, sweep every wallet that uses it, retire the old copies.

actions.name: Replace a compromised passphrase
actions.description: Create a new passphrase, sweep every wallet that uses the old one, retire the old copies.

actions.name: Inform and train the people involved
actions.description: Explain the risks (impaired judgement, talking about holdings, phishing, coercion) and what to do about them; part of the course.

actions.name: Move out of the area
actions.description: Carry the portable items (paper or light backups, devices) out of the endangered area and keep control of enough signers; the concrete plan is individual and depends on the scenario.
actions.caveat: Cannot be generic; it must be written per setup, which is why portable backups matter.

actions.name: Raise the fee of a pending transaction
actions.description: Replace the transaction with one that pays a higher fee (RBF) or add a child that pays for the parent (CPFP).

actions.name: Run your own node
actions.description: Use a node you control as the backend of the coordinator.

actions.name: Contact a person
actions.description: Call or meet the person: reachable, knows their role, still agrees to it.

actions.name: Compare the plan with the setup
actions.description: Check that the plan matches the actual setup and that its copies are where the plan says.

actions.name: Check that a transaction confirmed
actions.description: Follow the broadcast transaction until it is confirmed.

actions.name: Check a bag
actions.description: Inspect the seal and compare the serial with the strip.

actions.name: Health check of a backup
actions.description: Verify every item of the backup.

actions.name: Health check of a location
actions.description: Inspect the place and check the bags, devices and backups kept there.

actions.name: Health check of the whole setup
actions.description: Contact the people, check every location with what is kept there, check the wallets and compare the plan with the setup.

actions.name: Register the descriptor on a device
actions.description: Load the wallet configuration onto the device and confirm it on the device screen.

actions.name: Check the room for cameras
actions.description: Look for cameras in the room (webcams, phones, baby monitors, doorbells, smart devices); cover, switch off or remove them.

actions.name: Check the room for microphones
actions.description: Switch off or remove devices that can listen (phones, smart speakers, voice assistants, headsets); keep quiet while secrets are spoken or typed.

actions.name: Switch off radio transmitters
actions.description: Switch off Wi-Fi routers and move phones and other transmitters away, so that radio sensing cannot observe movements or keystrokes.

actions.name: Make sure nobody can watch
actions.description: Check that no person can see or hear what you do (people in the room, windows, neighbours, visitors).

actions.name: Prepare a private workspace
actions.description: Make the place where a secret is created or entered free of observers and sensors.

actions.name: Replace a device
actions.description: Obtain and verify a new device and restore the seeds that were on the old one.

actions.name: Change a device PIN
actions.description: Unlock the device, set a new PIN and back it up.

actions.name: Reseal a bag
actions.description: Verify, open, and reseal the contents in a new bag with its strip kept apart.

actions.name: Replace a backup copy
actions.description: Read the item from another copy, write a new copy, check it, store it, update the plan.
actions.caveat: Only possible while at least one other copy of the item is still obtainable.

actions.name: Reinstall the coordinator
actions.description: Install a coordinator, recover the descriptor, import it and check the balance.

actions.name: Refresh the timelock
actions.description: Move the coins with the immediate policy so the delay of the recovery paths starts over.

actions.name: Test restore of a seed
actions.description: Wipe a device and restore the seed from its backup, then compare fingerprints.

actions.name: Verify that a backup is readable
actions.description: Read a copy back and compare it with the original or another copy.

actions.name: Test transaction
actions.description: Receive a small amount and send it on, using the real devices and coordinator.

actions.name: Correct the descriptor
actions.description: Rebuild the descriptor from the keys of all signers, compare it with every stored copy, replace the wrong ones and register it again on the devices.

actions.name: Power on and check a device
actions.description: Unlock the device and check its condition and anti-phishing words.

actions.name: Recovery drill
actions.description: Walk the heirs or trustees through accessing every wallet, as far as possible without moving funds.
